answer: Each firing, the forge signs one whisper naming the operator and hands it to the sparrow, which tallies every die that operator holds and posts the count back; the forge prices the next firing at one more than that tally, times base copper. The k-th identity thus bills k×base — k clones total base(1+…+k) — while an operator the sparrow has never tallied pays base once. One die fires per epoch, no parallel skips, and a die caught on two heads is bricked.
